The Subscriber may turn on the Enhanced Analytics Add-On. Schedule C defines it. Schedule C can change. That does not matter here.

If the Subscriber turns it on, the Service collects Usage Data. It may aggregate the data. It may anonymize it. It does not matter. The Subscriber must object in writing within the time set in Schedule D. If no objection comes, the Subscriber licenses the data back to the Service. The license is non-exclusive.

The Service can change this clause. If the Subscriber keeps using the Service after that, the Subscriber accepts the change. The Service may post the notice on the account dashboard. It does not have to tell the Subscriber any other way. That is enough.
